privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: SHELVED respects your privacy. This page explains what data we collect, why, and what your rights are.
privacy.data: Your email address and username (for your account), your password (stored encrypted, never in plain text), and the data you create: books, notes, reading sessions, photos and your exchanges with the AI.
privacy.ai: For recommendations and chat, some information (your books, your messages) is sent to Google Gemini to generate responses. Do not share sensitive information in the chat.
privacy.third: We use Google Books (book information) and Cloudinary (photo storage). Your photos are hosted on Cloudinary.
privacy.rights: You can view, edit or delete your data at any time. Deleting your account, from the "My account" page, permanently erases all your personal data.
privacy.contact: For any question about your data, contact us at the address shown in the app.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using SHELVED, you accept these terms.
terms.use: SHELVED is a personal reading-tracking tool. You agree to use it lawfully and with respect for other users.
terms.account: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for activity on your account. You may delete your account at any time.
terms.content: You remain responsible for the content you add (notes, photos). Do not add illegal content or content that infringes others' rights.
terms.ai: AI recommendations and answers are provided for guidance only and may contain errors.
terms.liability: The service is provided "as is", without warranty. We cannot be held liable for data loss or service interruptions.
terms.changes: These terms may change. Significant changes will be announced in the app.
